theme.designMd:
# openhow Creator SaaS storyboard design system

Product: openhow, a Korean creator SaaS for VOD/class businesses.
Tone: trustworthy, premium, calm, conversion-focused, not childish.
Benchmark: Liveklass structure, but openhow identity is AI-era knowledge business platform.
Language: Korean UI copy.
Canvas: desktop web, 1440px wide, responsive sections.
Visual style:
- Clean SaaS editorial layout with generous whitespace.
- White / near-white background, deep ink text, subtle warm neutral cards.
- Accent color: deep indigo-blue for primary CTAs; emerald/mint for success signals and revenue/learning highlights.
- Rounded cards, soft shadows, clear section rhythm.
- Typography: modern Korean-friendly sans, strong large hero headings, readable cards.
Components to keep consistent across screens:
- Top nav with openhow/creator brand, text links, primary CTA.
- Course/Lesson cards with the standard six elements: tags, duration/capacity, creator, title, enrollment window, price, rating count.
- Pill tags: VOD, 기수제, 패키지, 무료 미리보기. Do not present LIVE/1:1/디지털 as active v1 features; only as vision copy on platform page.
- Sticky purchase CTA on course landing.
- Community cards as SEO trust signals.
Output expectation: high fidelity product mockup, real Korean text, realistic cards and spacing, no lorem ipsum.
